data_issues: Test-set dropout: 9 of the 25 units (rows 4,5,9,10,12,13,14,18,19; includes the highest-firing unit 5 and unit 13) record exactly zero spikes on all 120 test trials, while they fire normally in train/val (e.g. unit 5 mean ~3 spikes/bin, never zero in train). These are dead/disconnected channels or a unit-sorting/ordering mismatch in the test recording, not true silence. Decoder was trained on the 16 surviving units only; using all 25 would give ~0.6 val accuracy but would fail on test. Labels/image_id in train/val are consistent and balanced; no duplicate trials found.
